headline: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia, Microsoft 365 limps through a day-long outage, Starship eyes a double catch tonight, and Lawson keeps his Racing Bulls seat.

upcoming.what: Starship Flight 15 targets 22:45 Irish time from Starbase: first attempt to catch both booster and ship (FAA approval not yet confirmed, so it may slip)
UFC 334, Madison Square Garden: Gane vs Hokit (heavyweight title), Harrison vs Nunes. Main card about 02:00 Sun 15 Nov Irish time (TBC). ADCC Austin Open the same day
Leonid meteor shower peak; the crescent Moon sets early, so skies stay dark after midnight
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
Polaris 40, Southampton (Tonon vs McNally); UFC Doha: Prochazka vs Stirling
F1 Las Vegas GP, lights out around 04:00 Irish time (Sat night local)

items.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: Nvidia says its founder has stepped down as president, CEO and board member with immediate effect, after days of reports about chip diversion to China and board unrest. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches, and Harvey Jones becomes Nvidia's first board chair.

items.headline: Microsoft 365 outage drags into the night
items.summary: Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Intune and Defender were disrupted for much of Thursday. Microsoft blamed an overwhelmed secure-connection process on its servers, and early fixes kept failing as traffic returned.

items.headline: FAA rolls out its AI air traffic tool nationwide
items.summary: The US aviation regulator is expanding an AI-assisted air traffic system across the country, one of the biggest real-world deployments of AI in safety-critical infrastructure so far.

items.headline: Starship Flight 15 targets tonight for a double catch
items.summary: Ship 42 and Booster 22 are set to lift off from Starbase at 22:45 Irish time carrying Starlink V3 satellites, with SpaceX trying to catch both stages at the tower for the first time. FAA sign-off still hasn't been publicly confirmed, so treat the date as provisional.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: dark early, cloud unconfirmed
items.summary: Forecast sources were unreachable this morning, so check Met Éireann before heading out. Verdict: mixed. Sunset is about 16:40 with full darkness by about 18:40, and the thin crescent Moon sets early in the evening, so any clear spell after 19:00 is good for Saturn in the south and Jupiter rising later.

items.headline: Watchlist: Geralt's voice hasn't recorded for The Witcher 4 yet
items.summary: Doug Cockle says he hasn't been called in to record and knows almost nothing about Geralt's role, even though his voice featured in the reveal trailer. A hint that Geralt's part may be modest, or that recording is still a long way off.

items.headline: Watchlist: Borderlands 4 weekly rotation
items.summary: This week's server-side update brings Pango and Bango back as the Big Encore Boss, a new Wildcard mission with a Jakobs sniper reward, and a relocated Maurice's Black Market. No new client patch since V1.11 in October.

items.headline: The Crown recap: Mica Galvão ends Murasaki's run
items.summary: Last Sunday's IBJJF Crown saw Mica Galvão beat two-time champ Andy Murasaki at middleweight, while Erich Munis and Gabi Pessanha both made it four Crowns in a row by submission.

items.headline: Tye Ruotolo doubts Musumeci's MMA move
items.summary: Fresh off winning ONE's lightweight MMA title, Tye Ruotolo gave a lukewarm verdict on Mikey Musumeci's planned switch to MMA, questioning whether he has the scrapper's instinct.

items.headline: Dublin brown belt stops a late-night attacker
items.summary: A female brown belt says she took down a man who allegedly punched her while she cycled home in Dublin around 3am, with video doing the rounds.

items.headline: UFC 334 weigh-ins today, fight night tomorrow
items.summary: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight title and Harrison vs Nunes head Saturday's MSG card, with weigh-ins this morning New York time; Joselyne Edwards is on standby for the women's title fight. Main card around 02:00 Sunday Irish time. Little fresh news overnight.

items.headline: Lawson and Lindblad stay at Racing Bulls for 2027
items.summary: Red Bull kept its sister-team line-up after weighing Lawson against junior Nikola Tsolov. Lawson sits ninth in the standings, comfortably best of the midfield.

items.headline: Tsolov named Red Bull third driver, eyes 2028 seat
items.summary: The F2 title contender gets a heavy old-car testing programme and several FP1 outings next year, with a race seat targeted for 2028.

items.headline: Hamilton refuses to be silenced amid Ferrari tension
items.summary: After the Mexico flashpoint with Leclerc and Vasseur's rebuke of both drivers, Hamilton says he won't apologise for his radio outbursts. Antonelli still leads the title race on 390 points from Verstappen on 279.

items.headline: Tsunoda's Monza points go to appeal
items.summary: Audi has appealed the Italian GP result over Tsunoda's restart infringement, which kept Bortoleto just out of the points. The FIA court hears it in Paris on 25 November.
